entities.name: Project Lightning Bug
entities.description: Izzet project on Ravnica, run by Ral Zarek, that detects planeswalkers; later turned into a beacon calling planeswalkers against Bolas.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Izzet planeswalker, Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon who ordered the project.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker and Living Guildpact whose disappearances prompted the project.

entities.name: Maree
entities.description: Chamberlain to the Firemind who suggested tracking Jace and secretly improved the detector.

entities.name: Izmagnus Mizzix
entities.description: Worked with Maree to recalibrate the detector spell.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Criminal planeswalker detected by the project.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who reported seeing Tezzeret on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Jace fetched before leaving Ravnica.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker whose threat the beacon was meant to counter.

entities.name: Millena
entities.description: Dimir thoughtstealer who implanted the beacon idea at Bolas's behest.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius leader who consented to the Izzet taking over the tower top floors.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Azorius institution whose bell tower housed the beacon.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Bolas activated, trapping planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Bolas's spell cast on trapped planeswalkers.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the project was carried out.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet, curious about Jace's absences, has Maree suggest tracking him, and Ral is appointed Head Researcher.
events.quote: Ral Zarek was then appointed Head Researcher of the project

events.summary: Ral builds the tracking enchantment and an amplification field above the Tenth, weakening it so it would not prove planeswalkers exist.
events.quote: Ral tweaked his persistent storm to weaken its precision

events.summary: Maree and Izmagnus recalibrate the detector; Ral and Jace fabricate evidence it is unreliable, so Niv-Mizzet loses interest.
events.quote: which caused Niv-Mizzet to lose interest

events.summary: Ral learns of four planeswalkers on Ravnica and of Vraska, and warns Jace at a Rakdos Carnarium; Liliana reports Tezzeret on Kaladesh and Jace leaves with Gideon.
events.quote: Jace fetched Gideon and left Ravnica behind

events.summary: Spatial rifts immune to electrical magic begin appearing across Ravnica, possibly a side effect of the project.
events.quote: several unexplained spatial rifts began appearing all over Ravnica

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet has Ral turn the project into a beacon to call planeswalkers against Bolas, an idea planted by Millena.
events.quote: he had Ral turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon

events.summary: Bolas activates the Immortal Sun, trapping planeswalkers on Ravnica for the Elderspell.
events.quote: when Bolas activated the Immortal Sun

events.summary: After the Elderspell, Ral turns off the beacon to stop more planeswalkers arriving.
events.quote: This Ral was able to do.

relations.note: carried out the project by his order
relations.quote: carried out by Ral Zarek by order of Niv-Mizzet

relations.note: implanted the idea at Bolas's behest
relations.quote: at the behest of Bolas himself
Ral and Jace then contrived evidence that the system was demonstrably unreliable
